name: Why hire a general remodeling contractor instead of just a tile layer for a bathroom floor?

mainEntity.name: Why hire a general remodeling contractor instead of just a tile layer for a bathroom floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom floor tile installation involves several trades, including framing inspection, finish carpentry for trim, and plumbing disconnection and reattachment for toilets and vanities. Hiring an owner-operated general and finish contractor provides a single point of contact who oversees the entire scope. Instead of hiring separate plumbers, carpenters, and tile layers, a general contractor handles the demolition, subfloor leveling, waterproofing, tile setting, and finish carpentry while coordinating certified trade partners for plumbing connections. This ensures consistent quality, clear communication, and fewer scheduling delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor manages the entire project, coordinating subfloor repairs, plumbing fixtures, tile setting, and finish trim under a single point of contact.
